events.title: Demo of Ovis Mollis is now available + news.
events.summary: Right now you can already play the demo of Ovis Mollis. It offers a small slice of the beginning of the game, but if you really want to, you can play it endlessly. This kind of game experience is something new for us, so there's a chance you'll run into bugs, even though we meticulously tried to clean them all up to make the demo fairly comfortable to play.Now for the news. events.title: “Ovis Mollis” is taking part in the “Companion Falls for You!”
events.summary: “Ovis Mollis” is taking part in the “Companion Falls for You!” festival. You can check out our game and many others on the festival page on Steam. You may also notice that we’ve changed our game’s capsule. We noticed that many people liked the gas station cashier girl from our game. We thought: why not depict her on the poster? Work on the game is in full swing, and adding the game to your wishlists is very important.

events.title: Companion Farm "Ovis Mollis" Announcement
events.summary: Hello everyone! Today we are announcing our new game called Ovis Mollis. It's a woolly sheep companion farm with an economy and cosmetic items that drop directly into your Steam inventory. We would appreciate your support on social media and adding the game to your wishlists.
